prompt: <<<image_1>>> = protagonist design reference for the only visible body parts: armored gloves, forearms, trousers, tactical boots and rifle; <<<image_2>>> = enemy design reference; <<<image_3>>> = opening first-person attack and firing composition; <<<image_4>>> = multiple-enemy reveal; <<<image_5>>> = the second creature rushing the camera. Style & Mood: Ten-second uninterrupted pure first-person live-action tactical-horror shot. The camera is physically attached to the protagonist’s head and torso, never floating outside the body. Cold cyan industrial corridor, dense haze, practical lights, urgent handheld motion, strong immersion, realistic breathing, recoil and body weight. Dynamic Description: Begin in absolute first-person POV. Never show the protagonist’s face, head, back or full body; only the rifle, gloved hands, armored forearms and, during the final move, one trousered leg and tactical boot may enter frame. A distant red-eyed creature from <<<image_2>>> charges directly toward the lens as in <<<image_3>>>. The protagonist raises the rifle into the lower frame and fires a tight rapid burst of blue-white rounds. Real recoil jolts the hands and viewpoint while the sights remain on target. The creature breaks apart into black smoke and shadow particles without gore. Without cutting, the rifle pulls close to the chest and the protagonist performs one grounded shoulder roll. The horizon rotates exactly once with the body, the camera passes close to the scuffed floor, then rises rapidly as the protagonist plants a hand and regains a crouched stance. As the view comes upright, multiple distant red-eyed silhouettes from <<<image_4>>> are revealed across the corridor and side openings. They remain a background group; only one creature acts. Almost immediately, one enemy from <<<image_5>>> explodes forward and rushes straight at the lens. The protagonist reacts without pause: the first-person camera snaps backward with the torso, drops sharply toward knee height, and tilts slightly upward as the body sinks into a low crouch. From the bottom of frame, the protagonist’s trousered leg and tactical boot sweep across the image in one fast horizontal low sweep, striking the charging creature’s legs and knocking it sideways past the camera. The leg belongs to the camera wearer and must remain anatomically connected to the unseen first-person body. End in the low crouched POV, rifle and forearms returning into frame while the remaining red eyes close in. Static Description: Real metal corridor, pipes, doors, cold practical lamps, haze and scuffed floor. One continuous first-person shot, no cuts, no third-person angle, no external view of the protagonist, no mirror or reflection. Avoid floating-camera movement, extra arms or legs, detached limbs, rubber hands, sliding feet, impossible roll direction, repeated horizon spins, weapon deformation, plastic CGI materials, duplicate attacking creatures and excessive motion blur that hides the action.

<<<image_1>>>＝主角造型参考，只用于第一人称画面中允许出现的装甲手套、前臂、黑色长裤、战术靴和步枪；<<<image_2>>>＝敌人造型参考；<<<image_3>>>＝开场第一人称怪物扑来与开火构图；<<<image_4>>>＝起身后发现群怪的空间参考；<<<image_5>>>＝第二只怪物冲向镜头的参考。风格与氛围：10秒一镜到底，纯真人实拍的完全第一人称战术恐怖镜头。摄影机真实绑定在主角头部与躯干，绝不漂浮到身体外。冷青工业走廊、浓雾、实体灯光，强烈手持晃动和紧急代入感，同时保留真实呼吸、身体重量与枪械后坐力。动态描述：从绝对第一人称主观视角开始。全程绝不出现主角的脸、头部、背部或完整身体；只允许看见步枪、戴手套的双手、装甲前臂，以及最后扫堂腿时短暂进入画面的单条裤腿和战术靴。参考<<<image_3>>>，远处一只符合<<<image_2>>>造型的红眼怪物沿走廊直线扑向镜头。主角把步枪抬入画面下方，立即连续发射集中明亮的蓝白色子弹；双手与视角随真实后坐力短促震动，但瞄准线始终锁定目标。怪物被命中后碎成黑色烟雾和暗影颗粒，不要血浆。摄影机不切，主角把枪收近胸前，完成一次真实贴地肩部翻滚。地平线只随身体完整旋转一圈，镜头贴近磨损地面掠过，随后主角撑地快速起身，视角回到低位半蹲高度。画面重新竖直的一瞬间，参考<<<image_4>>>，走廊纵深和两侧入口中出现多只红眼黑影；它们只作为背景包围群体，只有一只执行攻击。几乎没有停顿，参考<<<image_5>>>，其中一只怪物突然全速冲向镜头。主角瞬间向后一仰，第一人称镜头随躯干快速后撤并下降到膝盖高度，身体同时沉入低位蹲姿。紧接着，主角的一条黑色裤腿和战术靴从画面下方高速横向扫过，完成一次低位扫堂腿，击中冲锋怪物的双腿，把它扫向镜头侧面。画面中的腿必须属于摄影机佩戴者，与未入镜的第一人称身体保持正确连接，不能凭空出现。结尾保持低位半蹲的第一人称视角，步枪与双臂重新进入画面，其余红眼黑影继续逼近。静态描述：真实金属走廊、管线、侧门、冷色实体灯、雾气和磨损地面。全程一镜到底，不要切镜，不要第三人称，不要从外部拍到主角，不要镜面反射。避免漂浮摄影机、手臂或腿增生、肢体断开、橡胶手、脚底滑行、翻滚方向错误、地平线反复旋转、枪械变形、塑料CG材质、攻击怪物复制和遮住动作的过量运动模糊。
